title: An inspector's round of a small café
checked: Every reachable state checked (8 states, 22 with their data, 27 steps). All 4 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 8 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.

rules.rule: The kitchen only through the counter
rules.says: No door joins the seating to the kitchen. The only way in is behind the counter, where staff put a hairnet on, so in the kitchen and the store the hairnet is always on.
rules.path: Take away the hairnet on guard and it breaks in 6 steps: next door, next door, next door, back out, next door, into the kitchen.

rules.says: The seating has 20 seats. A group of four comes in only when four seats are free.
rules.path: Take away the 4 seats free guard and it breaks in 2 steps: a group comes in, a group comes in.

rules.rule: The report comes after the kitchen
rules.says: The inspector writes the report only after she has seen the kitchen.
rules.path: Take away the kitchen seen guard and it breaks in 3 steps: next door, next door, write the report.
